newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes cave to May paper expiry, grades drop.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes cave to May paper expiry, grades drop.

text.p: U.S. crudes rode along a rocky path Tuesday, declining sharply with expiration-related paper markets to a sharp sell-off Tuesday.

Traders said cash dealings focused on wide fluctuations in May/June West Texas Intermediate/Cushing. The spread between the two months, or roll, started at 25-30 cents in favor of May, but quickly worked down to even with second month June. For the rest of the session, roll talk moved in various directions, ending around flat to 5 cts in June's favor.
May WTI talked late at $19.55-65 a barrel, 70 cts lower than Monday's performance.
